summary: The package's entry point. Wraps an app (a request handler function, or an already-listening Server) in an http(s) server and returns a chainable object with one method per HTTP verb; the actual request/response assertion logic lives in lib/test.js. Also re-exports Test, .agent(), and cookie assertions.
